subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What identity contract should iOS Remote Domain mode use when a manually entered hostname has a valid system-trusted TLS chain but its leaf certificate changes between connections?
rationale: The current fingerprint also helps classify the endpoint as trusted for credential fallback, so replacing leaf pinning cannot be decided safely as a mechanical certificate-handling fix.

options.title: Separate public-CA trust mode
options.body: Use CA and hostname validation for manually entered public domains, retain leaf pinning for discovered or self-signed endpoints, and bind gateway identity through authenticated pairing.

options.title: Retain strict leaf pinning
options.body: Keep the current security model and explicitly document rotating or anycast TLS terminators as unsupported for Remote Domain mode.

options.title: Support managed pin rotation
options.body: Keep pinning but introduce a narrowly defined multi-pin or rotation protocol, accepting the additional migration and lifecycle complexity.

recommendation.title: Separate public-CA trust mode
recommendation.body: Use CA and hostname validation for manually entered public domains, retain leaf pinning for discovered or self-signed endpoints, and bind gateway identity through authenticated pairing.
